visible_assumptions.text: Deposit taken as the number of months the listing states.
Brokerage assumed between 0 and 1 month's rent unless the listing says otherwise.

default_questions: How many days after I leave is the deposit refunded?
What is the notice period, and is any rent forfeited?
How is electricity billed (metered, per-unit rate, or fixed)?

error_messages.INVALID_URL: Paste the full link, starting with https://
error_messages.SALE_LISTING: This looks like a sale listing. ProofRent checks rentals and PGs.
error_messages.LOGIN_REQUIRED: This page needs a login. ProofRent reads public pages only.
error_messages.LISTING_REMOVED: This listing appears to be removed. Worth asking whether the place is still available.
error_messages.REDIRECT_UNRESOLVED: We couldn't open that short link. Please paste the direct listing link.
error_messages.RATE_LIMITED: We're busy right now. Retrying shortly.
error_messages.INTERNAL: Couldn't compute this part. You can retry.
